items.takeaway: The debate has shifted from whether China's pharma services sector is recovering to how long the cycle can run, with 2027 order visibility now the key swing factor for further re-rating.
items.top_takeaway: The China CDMO cycle is broadening from GLP-1 commercial demand into early-stage R&D, improving visibility into 2027 rather than just this year.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley reads China's bank and insurer recapitalization as preventive stability policy, not a credit-expansion signal
items.title: MS Wednesday Cyclicals Roundtable: China Bank Recapitalization, Insurance Law Revision, Container Shipping, and Existing-Home Sales
items.standfirst: This week's cross-sector roundtable covers a smaller-than-expected RMB300bn state bank injection spread more broadly across insurers and policy lenders, an overhauled Insurance Law tightening risk-based supervision, a container-shipping
items.takeaway: Across financials and property, the common thread is capital discipline over expansion: banks are recapitalized to withstand volatility rather than to lend more, insurers are told to hold more capital against risk rather than scale, and
items.top_takeaway: The recapitalization wave reads as balance-sheet insurance for banks and insurers rather than fuel for credit or premium growth acceleration.
